subject: Post-call: spend compaction options and next-step checklist
messages:
From: Alex Farrell <alex.farrell@maplepay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tim O'Neal <tim.oneal@maplepay.com>
Date: 2028-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro call recap

Thanks for the call this morning, Logan. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying items before we sync with procurement:

- Primary pain: token spend volatility month-over-month. We can't forecast credit burn when features ramp.
- Performance constraint: some user flows require sub-400ms median generation for single-turn prompts; batching can't break the UX.
- Budget cap: Q2 budget is fixed; we need a clear projection of unit cost with and without batching/caching and with a Dedicated capacity baseline.
- Security ask: our security team will send the SOC2 questionnaire (attached) — want to understand what evidence is routine vs. one-off.

Requests:
1) A concise TCO worksheet that shows token-econ scenarios (current usage, +30% growth, and peak day) with batching and cache assumed at low/medium/high efficiencies.
2) A short walkthrough/demo of batching behavior and latency trade-offs (video or recording is fine).
3) Pricing anchor for a pilot (3 months, dev -> prod traffic 100K tokens/day average) and what discount/commit looks like.

Can you send those to Tim and me? We'll share with procurement/security and aim to reconvene next week.

Thanks,
Alex Farrell
CFO, MaplePay
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Farrell <alex.farrell@maplepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tim O'Neal <tim.oneal@maplepay.com>
Date: 2028-02-14T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro call recap

Alex — great to meet you both. Appreciated the clarity on constraints. Quick confirmation of what we'll deliver and proposed next steps: 

Deliverables (by end of day Tuesday):
- RW-compact-batching-worksheet.xlsx (TCO scenarios: baseline, +30% growth, peak day; includes toggles for batching size, KV cache hit rate, and dedicated pool pricing).
- 7-minute batching-demo.mp4 showing real-time latency delta for single-turn vs 16-request micro-batch and a short section on prefix/KV caching behavior.
- Short pricing note: pilot anchor (3 months) with token tier and committed throughput options + one-off Dedicated seat pricing.

Suggested follow-ups:
- Wed 11am PT: 30-minute walk-through to go through the worksheet and answer procurement's questions.
- If helpful, we can run a short controlled pilot with a 48-hour burst to validate savings numbers on your traffic pattern.

Security: I saw the questionnaire in your next note — Marissa (cc) will own the SOC2/evidence pack and will follow up with a mapping doc.

Attachments: RW-compact-batching-worksheet.xlsx (draft), batching-demo.mp4 (recording link inside workbook).

Next step for you: confirm Wed 11am PT or propose two alternative times.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Tim O'Neal <tim.oneal@maplepay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Farrell <alex.farrell@maplepay.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T08:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro call recap

Logan — Wed 11am PT works for us. Thanks for the fast turnaround. Couple of micro-asks for the worksheet:
- Please include an explicit row that models user-perceived P50 latency for single-turn requests when batching is applied (so our PM can validate UX risk).
- For caching, show a conservative (15%), realistic (35%), and optimistic (60%) hit-rate scenario.

I'll upload the security questionnaire (MaplePay-security-questions.pdf) to your Drive folder after I attach it here.

Tim O'Neal
Product Lead, MaplePay
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-02-16T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: spend compaction options and next-step checklist

Looping in a pricing note for our internal anchor before Wed:
- Pilot anchor (3 months): list price token tiers + 15% pilot discount and a refundable usage commit that converts to a reserved Dedicated seat at month 4 if they opt-in.
- If they want a stronger commitment, offer a 10% uplift on the pilot discount for a 12-month reserved capacity commitment.
- Call out gating: vendor SOC2 evidence and an ops-onboarding checklist (scheduling + test corpus for eval) before enabling Dedicated pool.

I've attached the security mapping doc and the draft pricing anchor to the Drive folder referenced in the thread. Will be on the Wed walk-through to handle deeper pricing questions.

—Marissa
Head of GTM Finance | Redwood Inference
